_about: Virgil in English: Aeneid, Georgics, Eclogues, translator recorded per title. Two translators cover all three works: James Rhoades (verse; his complete Poems of Virgil, Oxford 1921, raw IA OCR, plus clean Gutenberg Georgics and Eclogues) and John Conington (prose; the Aeneid clean on Gutenberg, the complete Works of Virgil, 1880, raw IA OCR). Further Aeneid witnesses: Mackail (prose, 1885), William Morris (verse, 1876), E. Fairfax Taylor (Spenserian verse, 1903-07), Rolfe Humphries (verse, 1951; Gutenberg clears it as US public domain, not PD elsewhere). Mackail's prose Eclogues and Georgics (1889; 1910 reprint) on IA. Dryden's Virgil lives on the DRYDEN shelf (lane C) and is cross-referenced, never fetched here. Latin-facing Loebs of 1930 or earlier added 2026-10-02 as raw IA OCR (translator per row); the scan's printing was checked for a post-1930 revision notice where its title verso survives. Older translations from the wishlist added 2026-10-02 as raw IA OCR (translator per row).
